From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cascadesys.com>

Subject: Re: Cascade Systems — demo next week

Hi Grace,

Quick note — leadership just pulled our platform team into a Q4 feature sprint that starts this coming week. The team working on the POC will be redeployed to a launch stability effort, so we can't commit engineering time for the LLM pilot right now.

I hate to do this last-minute, but can we release the demo slot we had for next Wed? We still want to pick this up, but realistically we'll be able to re-engage during the January planning window. If you have a waitlist or a soft hold option, please put us there.

I'll loop in Sarah (product) — she's copied — to confirm timeline expectations. Thanks for understanding.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Engineering
Cascade Systems

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and totally understand.

We can release the slot and place Cascade on our Q1 re-engage waitlist. A couple quick items so we can keep the thread tidy:
- I'll remove the calendar invite for next Wednesday and mark the deal as "deferred" in HubSpot (I'll link the record below).
- Marcus, can you add Cascade to our "re-engage Jan window" nurture cadence and flag for a touch in early December?
- Jordan (CS), would you be able to assemble a short one-pager outlining what minimal engineering involvement looks like at re-onboarding so Liam's team can estimate effort when they return?

Attached: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_CASCADE_v2.docx (outline we were working from) and a small note from Liam's product team we received earlier — saves context.

Liam, happy to keep a soft hold rather than fully cancel if that helps your planning — we can also offer a brief async walkthrough for stakeholders who won't be hands-on. Let me know which you'd prefer.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Thanks Grace — appreciate the flexibility.

Let's release the calendar slot and put us on the soft-hold / waitlist for Jan. We'll plan to revisit during annual planning the week of Jan 10; I'll confirm a point person then. For procurement: our ops team asked if Redwood can keep the initial proof-of-concept pricing proposal on file until we re-open talks — no signature or commitment, just the doc on hold so we don't need to renegotiate from scratch. Who should they coordinate with?

Sarah and I are okay with an asynchronous, high-level product video for exec stakeholders in the meantime. That would be useful for maintaining momentum.

— Liam
